draft_en.subject: PoE++ switch instead of stacking injectors - for your next camera site
draft_en.body:
Hi Tomasz,

I hope the two 90 W injectors ran the PTZ cameras as expected.

If the next site needs several high-power ports, one switch is cheaper and cleaner than stacking injectors: DIN-rail industrial 8 x Gigabit PoE (two of them PoE++ 60-90 W) + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, -40 to 75 C, 240 W budget, model STI-288DGGPM-2BT - $154 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). It goes in a cabinet; we do not make outdoor IP67 housings, so for a pole-mounted box it would sit inside your enclosure with a 48 V supply.

One question: how many 60-90 W devices per cabinet does the next site need?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
